title: Chris Ramsay sees tic tac over Nellis

tellings.quote: He was flying a commercial flight over Nellis testing range and he saw that that tic tac that I showed you guys.

plain: While on a commercial flight over the Nellis test range, a military testing area in Nevada, a man named Chris Ramsay saw a white oval object shaped like a Tic Tac mint, like one Michels had shown on screen. Michels passes this on from Ramsay during a debate with the UFO skeptic Mick West, as a case of an ordinary passenger seeing such an object.
